name: Speckle Correlation Acquisition for Phase Functions
aliases: Direct Phase Function Acquisition via Speckle Correlation
Direct acquisition of volumetric scattering phase function using speckle correlations
Direct material acquisition using speckle correlations
definition: A method to acquire volumetric scattering phase functions by measuring speckle correlations from scattered light, avoiding the need for ground-truth single-scattering references which are difficult to obtain for thick media.
summary: Speckle Correlation Acquisition extracts volumetric scattering phase functions directly from speckle image correlations, avoiding inverse rendering optimization and enabling accurate measurements in thick media.
